tasks.summary_en: Line of $n$ people, $12\times$ more arrangements. Find $n$
tasks.statement_en: Among $n$ people there are Ania and her two friends. All these $n$ people are lined up one behind another. The number of all such arrangements is 12 times greater than the number of all such arrangements of these $n$ people in a line in which Ania and her two friends occupy three consecutive places (in any order). Compute $n$. Show your working.

The probability that a heating-network failure occurs in the morning hours on a single day at a certain housing estate equals $0.1$. Compute the probability of event $A$ that, in a period of seven days, there will be at most two days on which this network fails in the morning hours at this estate. Give the result as a decimal rounded to hundredths. Show your working.

The function $f$ is defined by $f(x)=2x^3-4x^2+9x$ for every real number $x$. The point $P=(x_0,18)$ belongs to the graph of $f$. Compute $x_0$ and find the equation of the tangent line to the graph of $f$ at point $P$. Show your working.
tasks.notes: only x_0 is numeric; the tangent-line equation is symbolic and not counted in value

tasks.statement_en: Given is the infinite geometric series $2x-\dfrac{6x}{x-1}+\dfrac{18x}{(x-1)^2}-\dfrac{54x}{(x-1)^3}+\dots$. Find all values of the variable $x$ (different from $0$ and from $1$) for which the sum of this series exists and equals $\dfrac{15}{2}$. Show your working.
Solve the equation $\sin(5x)+\cos x=0$ in the set $\left[-\dfrac{\pi}{2},\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right]$. Show your working.
tasks.notes: sum of the five solutions in the interval: -pi/8+3pi/8-5pi/12-pi/12+pi/4 = 0

tasks.summary_en: Triangle $ABC$ in circle $(x-1)^2+(y-2)^2=25$. Find its area
tasks.statement_en: Triangle $ABC$ is inscribed in the circle with equation $(x-1)^2+(y-2)^2=25$. Side $AB$ of this triangle is contained in the line with equation $4x-3y+2=0$. The altitude $CD$ of this triangle divides side $AB$ so that $|AD|=4\cdot|DB|$. Compute the area of triangle $ABC$. Show your working.

The sequence $(a,b,c)$ is a three-term geometric sequence with positive terms. The sequence $(2a,2b,c+1)$ is a three-term arithmetic sequence. Moreover, the condition $c-b=6$ is satisfied. Compute $a$, $b$ and $c$. Show your working.

tasks.summary_pl: Czworokąt wpisany w okrąg $r=4$. Oblicz boki (suma)
tasks.summary_en: Cyclic quadrilateral, $r=4$. Find the side lengths (sum)
tasks.statement_en: A convex quadrilateral $ABCD$ is inscribed in a circle of radius $4$. Angles $BAD$ and $BCD$ are right angles (see figure). The diagonals $AC$ and $BD$ of this quadrilateral intersect at point $E$ so that $|BE|=3\cdot|DE|$ and $|BD|=2\cdot|AE|$. Compute the lengths of the sides of quadrilateral $ABCD$. Show your working. [Figure: convex quadrilateral ABCD inscribed in a circle, diagonals AC and BD meeting at E]
tasks.notes: sum of the four side lengths AB+BC+CD+AD
height h=d/sqrt(3) is expressed in terms of the given parameter d, not a specific number
